THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

THE SCENE

Your team is playing the school escape room. You are alone in the last room. The clock shows ten minutes left. The lock has four strings. Each string needs one card. Four people each have one card.

THE HISTORY

This escape room is about the Inca and their khipu. In South America, the Inca kept numbers on strings with knots. The strings hung in groups. A top string could show the total of its group.
